fitAnalysis.assessment:
At 68%, you are a fair fit for this FP&A Analyst role, with solid core finance skills but meaningful tool and domain gaps.

**Strengths:**
- 5 years of FP&A experience: budgeting, rolling forecasts, and variance analysis
- Advanced Excel (INDEX/MATCH, VBA) and Power BI dashboards built on SAP data
- ACCA in progress (9 of 13 papers) signals serious technical finance commitment

**Gaps:**
- No Tableau, Metabase, or Pigment experience (all listed as required or preferred)
- No demonstrated ROI analysis or consumption-based software business model exposure
- PowerPoint not evidenced, despite its use in board-level reporting at this role

**Recommendation:** Apply now, but open your cover letter by connecting your manufacturing and retail FP&A work to Datadog's cost and headcount planning needs, and note that you are actively building familiarity with Pigment and AI tools to close the software-stack gap.

coverLetter:
Tomas Brandt
Chicago, IL, USA
tomas.brandt@example.com
+1 555 0123

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Datadog

Dear Hiring Manager,

Forecasting models that drift from reality create noise at the leadership level, and noisy numbers slow decisions. I rebuilt a forecast model around order backlog data and moved accuracy from 88% to 96%, turning a recurring problem into a reliable planning tool. Datadog's R&D Finance team works directly with engineering and product leadership on the company's most critical investment decisions, and that kind of model discipline is exactly what those conversations require.

As a Financial Analyst at Calder Industrial Components, I own monthly forecasting and variance reporting for two business units, and I've spent five years building the budgeting and management reporting skills this role calls for. I also shortened month-end close reporting from nine working days to six by automating journal checks in Excel VBA, which freed up capacity for the kind of cross-functional, analytical work Datadog describes. My Power BI dashboards built on SAP data gave plant managers clearer visibility into their numbers; I'd apply the same approach to BI tools in Datadog's environment as I get up to speed on the platforms your team uses.

I'd welcome the chance to talk through how my background fits the R&D Finance team's work. I'm available at your convenience.

Best regards,
Tomas Brandt

My CV and cover letter are attached with more detail. I'm available for a conversation any time this week or next.

Best regards,
Tomas Brandt
